text: Teaching Objective To cultivate senior applied Stomatology talents with strong hands-on skills, entrepreneurial ability, and strong ability to develop. To cultivate Doctors for diagnosis and treatment of stomatological disease. Main courses Biochemistry, Physiology, Medical Immunology, medical microbiology, Experiment of medical functional science, Pathology, pharmacology, clinical diagnostics, oral anatomical physiology, oral histology and pathology, internal medicine, surgery, Cariology And Endodontics, Periodontics, oral mucosal disease study, oral and maxillofacial surgery, prosthodontics, orthodontics, prevention of oral medicine. Graduates acquire following knowledge and ability 1.Basic theoretical knowledge and experimental skills of preclinical medicine and clinical medicine 2.Basic theoretical knowledge and clinical operational skills of various disciplines of Stomatology; 3.Dentistry common disease diagnosis, treatment and initial processing of urgent, difficult, severe symptom; 4.A basic knowledge of dental work and general skills; 5.Mastering medical literature search, the basic method of data survey, with initial capacity of oral medical research. Internship and Employment A total of 3,541 graduates of our school graduate in 2012, of which a total of 42 graduates of doctoral students, graduate students were 883 (including 27 foreign students, Hong Kong, Macao and Taiwan regions student 4), a total of 191 seven-year Accelerated Degree Graduation students, 2425 of undergraduate and the specialist graduates (including 825 Zhongshan College graduates). There are more than 90 graduates from the Stomatology employed by hospital in different provinces.
